page.overview:
Who is Reiko?

Reiko is a character in the Mortal Kombat fighting game series. He made his debut in Mortal Kombat 4, but didn't return as a playable character until Mortal Kombat Armageddon.

A new version of Reiko appears in Mortal Kombat 1 as a playable character for the first time in 16 years.

Reiko is a grim and stoic looking man with a penchant for brutality. He was originally introduced in a typical ninja archetype in Mortal Kombat 4, but was later redesigned to feature several similarities to Shao Kahn, including a desire to supplant him as the ruler of Outworld.

In the New Era, Reiko returns as a lieutenant to Shao, who's now a general.
